$comment: Hand-written. When to use each semantic token, for people and AI agents. scripts/tokens.mjs copies these into tokens/semantic.tokens.json as $description, and `npm run test:tokens` fails if a semantic token has no entry. figma-sync rewrites _semantic.scss but never this file. Contrast ratios are measured against #FFFFFF in the default theme.
--gds-color-brand-primary: Brand colour of the current product theme (blue in codex, orange in vpplayer). Use for brand marks and accents, not for interactive controls: use action-primary for those.
--gds-color-action-primary: Fill or text of the main interactive element: primary button, link, selected item, active tab indicator. 4.94:1 on white. One primary action per view.
--gds-color-action-primary-hover: action-primary on pointer hover. Use only as the :hover state of an element that uses action-primary.
--gds-color-action-primary-active: action-primary while pressed (:active) or toggled on. Use only as a state of an element that uses action-primary.
--gds-color-action-on-primary: Text and icons placed on an action-primary fill, such as the label of a primary button. 4.94:1 on action-primary.
--gds-color-text-primary: Default text: body copy, headings, table cell values, input values. 16.2:1 on white.
--gds-color-text-secondary: Supporting text that must stay readable: descriptions, subtitles, metadata, secondary table columns, and placeholders inside components. 6.96:1 on white (passes AA).
--gds-color-text-tertiary: Decorative or repeated text that is not needed to understand the screen. 2.96:1 on white: FAILS WCAG AA as text. Prefer text-secondary for anything a user must read.
--gds-color-text-disabled: Text and icons of disabled controls only. 2.13:1 on white, allowed by WCAG because disabled controls are exempt. Never use it to make active text look quieter.
--gds-color-text-placeholder: Legacy placeholder colour, kept for .gds-text-placeholder and as a chip fallback. 2.96:1 on white: FAILS WCAG AA. Components use text-secondary for placeholders since v2.6.2; do not use this for new work.
--gds-color-text-label: Form labels, table column headers, group titles in menus and panels. 8.5:1 on white.
--gds-color-text-helper: Secondary icons in components: table sort and row-action icons, tab close icon. 3.59:1 on white: passes the 3:1 minimum for icons, FAILS WCAG AA for text. For helper text under a field use text-secondary.
--gds-color-text-inverse: Text and icons on dark fills, such as a toast or a dark tooltip. Do not use on white.
--gds-color-bg-primary: Default surface: cards, inputs, modals, menus, table rows. White in the default theme.
--gds-color-bg-secondary: Page background behind cards (gds-page) and hover fill of secondary buttons and calendar days. Text colours keep AA on it except warning-text (4.36:1).
--gds-color-bg-tertiary: Pressed (:active) fill of secondary and ghost buttons, table header and striped rows, current page in pagination, skeleton blocks.
--gds-color-bg-disabled: Fill of disabled inputs and buttons. Pair with text-disabled.
--gds-color-border-default: Default border of inputs, cards, buttons and dividers. Decorative (1.34:1): never the only cue for a control's edge or state.
--gds-color-border-strong: Hover border of inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes and radios (.gds-border-hover). 2.96:1 on white, slightly under the 3:1 non-text minimum, so it must not be the only hover cue.
--gds-color-border-focus: Keyboard focus ring and focused input border. Every focusable element must show it on :focus-visible. 4.94:1 on white.
--gds-color-border-subtle: Light separators inside a surface: table row lines, menu and panel dividers, calendar grid.
--gds-color-error: Error fills, icons, dots and borders (input error border, error badge dot). 3.56:1 on white: never use as text colour, use error-text.
--gds-color-error-text: Error messages and error text. 6.31:1 on white.
--gds-color-success: Success fills, icons, dots and borders. 3.97:1 on white: never use as text colour, use success-text.
--gds-color-success-text: Success messages and success text. 6.86:1 on white.
--gds-color-warning: Warning fills, icons, dots and borders. 3.00:1 on white: never use as text colour, use warning-text.
--gds-color-warning-text: Warning messages and warning text. 4.67:1 on white, 4.36:1 on bg-secondary (fails AA there: place warning text on white).
